fields.statement: An AI assistant that answers from your documents.
fields.subheading: We build AI assistants that answer from your SOPs, manuals and records, and show the page each answer came from.

fields.heading: What *RAG* means
fields.body:
RAG stands for retrieval-augmented generation. The AI first finds the right passages in your documents, then writes its answer from them.

So it answers from your material and shows its source.

Around it we build custom automations: documents read and sorted, reports assembled, and workflows that run on their own.

items.title: Policy questions

items.after: An assistant answers from the policy, with the page it came from.

items.title: Invoices and POs

items.after: Invoices are read, checked and turned into entries for review.

items.title: Product knowledge

items.after: Any sales rep asks the assistant and gets the answer from your catalogue.

steps.title: Choose the documents
steps.text: We agree which documents the assistant may use, and who may ask it what.

steps.title: Prepare and index
steps.text: Documents are cleaned, split into passages and stored for search.

steps.title: Build and test
steps.text: We test it on real questions your team asks, and fix wrong answers.

steps.title: Run and update
steps.text: New documents are added as they change, and usage is monitored.

fields.heading: An assistant your team can *ask*
fields.body:
Ask in plain words, in the tools you already use: a web page, WhatsApp or your team's workspace.

Each answer cites the document and page, so staff can check it before acting.

items.question: Where are our documents kept?
items.answer: We agree with you which documents go in, where they are stored (your own AWS or Google Cloud account, if you prefer) and who can ask questions, before we build anything.

items.question: What if the assistant does not know?
items.answer: It should say so. We set it to answer only from your documents, and to say when it cannot find the answer.

items.question: Which documents work?
items.answer: PDFs, Word files, spreadsheets, SOPs, manuals, contracts and forms. Scanned pages are read with OCR first.

items.question: Can it answer on WhatsApp?
items.answer: Yes. The same assistant can answer on a web page, inside your team's tools, or on WhatsApp.
